sample_unit: ACLS exam questions (each posed three times to four LLMs)

links.outcome: Response consistency across three repeated runs of the same ACLS questions
links.effect: Fleiss' Kappa: ChatGPT-4o 1.0, Claude 3.5 0.89, Gemini 2.0 0.58, DeepSeek R1 0.58; overall accuracy (all three correct) ranged from 100% to 70%.
links.quote: Gemini 2.0 showed 86.0% overall accuracy with moderate consistency (Fleiss' Kappa = 0.58).

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the performance and consistency of several multimodal LLMs on Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS) exam questions without evaluating any deployment practice or safeguard.
